transcript.text: Maya, on the monitoring cadence, I can confirm from the payments operations side that we've built in real-time monitoring of net settlement positions on the rail, with threshold alerts set at 50% and 75% of the modeled peak outflow. That means alerts would trigger at $3,250,000 and $4,875,000 of net outflow. The intent is to give treasury sufficient lead time to arrange additional liquidity or collateral before we hit the $6,500,000 peak. I should note that the specific monitoring thresholds and alerting procedures are in my working notes but haven't yet been formally documented in the operating-plan file — I'll make sure those get incorporated before final sign-off. On the $2,500,000 gap, from a payments operations perspective, I'd recommend we escalate that for resolution after this meeting so it doesn't block the current sign-off, given that we have time between now and the September 1st activation date to identify additional funding sources or collateral.
